title: Align Decapod with Dactyl 0.11.0 registry release
intent: Fix issue 1380 and confirmed manifest publication failure by consuming published dactyl-db 0.11.0, updating lockfile, Nix vendoring, activation documentation and release-regression proof, preserving all backend and container behavior.
proof_hooks: cargo test --locked --lib --test release_dependency_policy --test cloud_dactyl_boundary --test cloud_supabase_boundary --test cloud_cli_boundary --test cloud_command_path
stop_conditions: No publish, release, tag, merge, deployment, or permission changes
deferred_questions: Native Nix packaging is unavailable locally and remains tracked by issue 1376; no hosted service proof is claimed.
